summary: Introduces a Path Segment Identifier for Segment Routing over MPLS. Because a list of segments may overlap with another path, an egress node cannot tell which path a packet took. A path identifier lets the egress recognize the path, which helps uses such as performance measurement and 1+1 path protection.

eli5.summary: Two buses may share many of the same stops, so a stop alone can't tell you which bus you rode. This adds a ticket number so the last stop knows exactly which route a packet took.
